Completed implementation of the lumon theme:
- Added standalone static/themes/lumon.css based on Antharchy/Omarchy lumon color palette.
- Added 'lumon' to AVAILABLE_THEMES in markusmd.themes.
- Added [data-theme="lumon"] styles to static/markus.css.
- Added BDD feature scenarios in features/themes.feature and updated features/site.feature.
- Verified with behave (all 63 scenarios passing) and ruff lint.
